segment_contamination_dimensions: Prefabricated and pre-engineered building product buyers — siblings such as 'Prefabricated Steel Buildings', 'Pre Engineered Building Structure', 'Pre Engineered Steel Building', and 'Prefabricated Industrial Buildings' target buyers purchasing factory-manufactured ready-to-assemble building products, not custom on-site fabrication and erection services; names implying a finished prefabricated product (e.g. 'PEB structure', 'pre-engineered building erection') risk attracting or being confused with these product MCATs and have been excluded from enhanced names.

Greenhouse, polyhouse, and agricultural structure buyers — siblings such as 'Agricultural Greenhouses', 'Greenhouse', 'Polyhouse', 'Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse', and 'Mini Greenhouse' target agricultural buyers seeking controlled-environment growing structures; these are incompatible with the industrial/manufacturing buyer persona of MS Structure Services and no agricultural or horticultural structure terms appear in any output.

Tensile and membrane structure buyers — siblings such as 'Tensile Structures', 'Modular Tensile Structure', 'Tensile Membrane Structures', and 'Auditorium Tensile Structure' target buyers seeking fabric/membrane canopy systems, not mild steel load-bearing frameworks; tensile structure terminology is excluded from all name candidates.
